sentences.text: CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH -----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Sabyasanchi, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rakesh Kumar Sinha, A.P.P.
---
03/12.12.2024 Heard the parties.

Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Barhait P.S. Case No. 37/2024, Corresponding to POCSO Case No. 40/2024, registered under Sections 376 DA/ 306/34 of the Indian Penal Code,
Sections 04/08 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge, POCSO Act,
Sahibganj.
On 11.04.2024, daughter of the informant committed suicide.
Before committing suicide, she had told her mother that she had eloped with co- accused Akbar Ansari.
After raping her, he sent her back home.
The deceased has not stated anything about the involvement of the petitioner.
It appears that after investigation police submitted charge-sheet under sections 306/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
It appears that co-accused Riyajul Ansari has been granted bail by this Court vide B.A. No.7043 of 2024 and the case of the petitioner stands on similar footing.
In view of the aforesaid fact, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, Sahibganj, in connection with Barhait P.S. Case No. 37/2024,
Bikash Turi vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
